verdict.rationale: Graphite's docs serve agent-friendly Markdown: get-started.md returns HTTP 200 with a 'Documentation Index' banner pointing agents to an llms index on its Mintlify site. However, the canonical https://graphite.com/llms.txt returns 404, so an agent pointed at the standard location gets nothing. Missing for 10: a working llms.txt at the root domain, verification that the referenced Mintlify llms index resolves, and first-party documentation of agent-oriented docs.
